_doc: NPC Relationships (design/gdd/npc-relationships.md, #46; Ties). pin: Formula A's pinned weights (kin, su_do both ways, ket_nghia, dao_lu, companion); feud: a blood feud holder's weight; soft: friend, rival, enmity (holder -> target) at full strength; debt: debtor -> creditor and creditor -> debtor at full strength. rate: Formula B fade in hundredths a season (the load rejects 0). Caps (rule 5): cap_ordinary, cap_notable, soft_reserve by class (the load rejects a reserve above its cap), met_notable_max. delta: Formula C's defaults. Formula D: feud_threshold, inherit_feud_max, inherit_enmity, inherit_debt, mourner_max. Formula F: master_cult_pct, daolu_cult_pct, help_min, help_max, favour_call_seasons, favour_cost_mult, errands_max by the player's realm, errand_margin, errand_cost_mult, avenger_max, gratitude_max. rival_gap: a close world fight in Power Rankings rating points. hook_slice_k: the incremental hook pass also recomputes 1 in k hook records each season as a safety net (AC-NR-31). rival_power_ratio: with Rankings off (the sims), a fight is close when the weaker has at least this share of the stronger's power (user decision 2026-11-21). Values are the GDD's guesses.
